notes:
The broad phrase code variants is interpreted as comment variants, following the supplied printed-p. 7 locator. A distinct across-snippets S1–S5 readability test is on printed p. 8 (χ² = 22.8; α = 0.004); it is not merged with the p. 7 test. The original labels the achieved significance α rather than p. Original title and DOI verified in accepted manuscript. Replication full text could not be obtained via the publisher DOI route, Unpaywall, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and targeted open-access searches; no statistics or replication verdict inferred from an abstract.
Source follow-up: Published conference article, pp.35–52. Rendered primary PDF pages 9,11,12 checked, including exact ANOVA digits. Requested page locator used to select ANOVA treatment statistic. Distinct primary Mack-Skillings MS = 0.744, p = 0.6752 on PDF p.11.
